items.author: electricbirds.bsky.social
items.context:
I can't decide which one to take on vacation. Sampling fun with Torso S4 or gaming madness with Steam Deck? I can only fit one...
image: A picture of a steam deck and the Torso s4 sampler
items.text: For travel I'd take the Steam Deck. Suspend mode lets you pause mid-game for a snack or a landing and pick up right where you left off.
items.verify: Если хочешь, проверь, что Deck и правда лучше для поездки; ответ шуточный и безопасный.
